args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

Dana, here's a draft recap from #inc-qfl-sev1 (you're in that channel). Times are as logged in the channel:

*DRAFT – Sev 1 recap: Quarrendon Freight Lines, Superior terminal dock schedule sync, 4 Nov 2025*
• *Broke:* Dana reported the sync wedged at 7:02 AM, saying it began around 6:40 AM Superior time. Tablets were spinning and drivers were backing up at the guard shack.
• *Cause found:* Samir Patel (on-call) at 7:17 AM: a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
• *Recovery:* Samir cleared the stuck jobs and Superior got a partial sync around 8:15 AM, though some inbound trailers were still duplicating.
• *Resolved:* Samir confirmed at 2:38 PM that the hotfix was deployed and the replay script finished, with all Superior dock schedules syncing cleanly in real time. Dana closed the incident at 2:44 PM after Thea gave a thumbs up from the yard.

Notes: the channel doesn't give a time zone for 6:40 AM, so check it before the exec call. I also haven't seen the postmortem notes, so there's no deeper root cause beyond the webhook listener. Edit freely, and tell me what to change.

I've posted the draft recap in #north-team. I built it from #inc-qfl-sev1, which you're in. The incident was on 4 Nov 2025.

- **Broke:** You reported the Superior dock schedule sync wedged at 7:02 AM and said it started around 6:40 AM Superior time.
- **Cause found:** Samir Patel (on-call) found it at 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Resolved:** Samir confirmed the hotfix was deployed and the replay script finished at 2:38 PM. You closed the incident at 2:44 PM after Thea gave a thumbs up.

The draft also covers the partial sync around 8:15 AM.

- **Time zone:** The channel doesn't give a time zone for the 6:40 AM start, so check it before the exec call.
- **Postmortem:** I haven't seen the postmortem notes, so there's no root cause beyond the webhook listener.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.
